payoff: Turn Your Hormones Into Your Superpower
shortDescription: Wild.AI is a health and fitness app designed specifically for women, leveraging hormonal data to optimize training and performance. It integrates with various wearables to provide tailored insights based on physiological data. Users can track their training, sleep, and heart rate, receiving personalized recommendations to enhance performance and prevent injuries. Ideal for athletes and active women seeking to train smarter.
pros: Personalized insights based on hormonal data
Tailored to improve women's training and recovery
cons: Temperature and activities data not available with Oura integration
